verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents Universal Login as hosted, "production-ready, branded login experiences" with brand customization. It also offers a no-code Forms editor for building custom signup and login flows, and Actions for prompting users for extra profile data stored as metadata. A community user independently confirms the Universal Login hosted page works well. missing for 10: an end-user self-service profile management UI (only progressive profiling and metadata capture are evidenced), embeddable prebuilt sign-in/sign-up UI components for app frameworks (the pre-built components cited are for B2B org admin), and in-depth docs on customizing the hosted pages.
